name: YEP! Youth Employment Program
org: San Francisco Recreation and Park Department
what_you_do: First-job experience at rec centers and parks: arts, sports, aquatics, gardening, cooking and facility operations.
who_can_apply: Teens ages 14 to 17 in San Francisco.
pay_detail: Pay not posted on the page read
duration: Up to 25 hours per week in summer; 10 hours per week in the school year
deadline_text: No dates posted. Email the program to ask when the next round opens.
how_to_apply: Email yep@sfgov.org or call Yuri Ugarte at 415-452-3863.
notes: This page replaced the older Workreation name on the department site. An older listing says applicants need work-permit papers and no citizenship is required.
